name: Zen (Not real name)

notable_features: Elaborate ear piercings with runic etchings
Faint crescent-shaped birthmark behind her left ear

ideals: Loyalty to family above all else
flaws: Compulsively lies to protect her identity
Reckless when someone mentions her brother
personality.bond: She carries her brother’s signet ring hidden beneath her cloak, a constant reminder of her mission.
personality.motivation: To find the mage who cursed her brother and discover the truth behind the betrayal of the royal house

background.origin_story: Born the youngest of the royal siblings in Elfheim, Zen vanished after her brother—heir to the throne—was struck by an enchanted sleep during a court coup. Presumed dead, she cast off her name and identity, becoming a ghost in the criminal underworld, gathering secrets and blades alike.
notable_events: Stole a sacred relic from the Cathedral of Light and lived
Escaped capture by the Silent Blades three times
Discovered hidden messages encoded in the palace tapestry
background.current_goal: Find a way to awaken her brother, the elf prince, from his enchanted sleep

fears: Being forced to reclaim her title
religion_or_beliefs: Publicly irreverent, privately whispers old elven prayers to the god of hidden truths

allies: Kael the Fence – smuggler with a soft spot for Zen
Rissa of the Lantern – informant and sometimes rival
Rupert the male Hume. A Red mage. Also Warrior of Light, like you
Theo the male Hume. A Warrior. Also Warrior of Light, like you
Merp the Dwarf. A White mage / Monsterologist. Also Warrior of Light, like you
rivals: Lady Virelle – noble enchantress who suspects Zen’s identity
‘The Listener’ – a bounty hunter with a vendetta
relationships.romantic_interest: A charming street performer named Jarel who unknowingly carries a fragment of the prince's curse

inventory: Lockpick set in a hollowed-out locket
A torn page from her brother’s enchanted journal
secrets: Her real name is Princess Zenyra of House Ithalara
She was partially responsible for her brother’s condition by trusting the wrong court mage
quotes: Truth’s just a blade you keep hidden until it's time to cut.
I’m nobody. Which is why everyone should be scared of me.
theme_music: Haunting flute melody layered over a dark string rhythm—mysterious, agile, mournful
adventure_history: After discovering the handheld dark crystal, you were chosen as one of the 4 warriors of light to save the world.
You have been magically transported just outside the city of Cornelia, where you find yourself with 3 strange new companions.
